question: __________________ unveiled FREE-AI framework to drive ethical AI adoption in finance.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**RBI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• RBI unveils FREE-AI framework to drive ethical AI adoption in finance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Reserve Bank of India** (RBI) released a report on **Framework for Responsible and Ethical Enablement of Artificial Intelligence** (FREE-AI) in the financial sector.

 
 
• 
 
The report includes **seven guiding “sutras”** for AI adoption in the sector.

 
 
• 
 
It offers **26 recommendations** under **six strategic pillars** to balance **innovation** and **risk mitigation**.

 
 
• 
 
The **FREE-AI Committee**, formed by RBI on **December 6, 2024**, aims to promote innovation while safeguarding **consumer interests**.

 
 
• 
 
**Objective**: Develop a **responsible** and **ethical AI adoption** framework for banking and finance.

 
 
• 
 
**Chairperson**: Dr. **Pushpak Bhattacharyya**.

 
 
• 
 
**Mandate**: Balance **technological advancement** with **transparency**, **accountability**, **fairness**, and **customer protection**.
